T197_primary.analysis_population: Each held-out laboratory-anchor fold; the target set is the exact intersection of rank-eligible accessions in the two development sources.
T197_primary.prediction_row: one source-local rank-percentile observation for one frozen canonical accession
T197_primary.primary_contrast: paired batch-level full-sequence ridge minus composition-only ridge
T197_primary.primary_metric: arithmetic mean of held-out measurement-batch Spearman correlations within each outer fold
T197_primary.uncertainty: percentile bootstrap over held-out measurement batches, 2,000 resamples per fold/model/metric

T198_primary.analysis_population: The 141 biological units represented in the CC-BY paper-attached cohort at the predeclared threshold of at least 10 mapped positive proteins per subject-particle batch.
T198_primary.prediction_row: one source-local rank-percentile observation for one mapped canonical accession
T198_primary.primary_contrast: full-sequence ridge versus composition-only ridge; paired batch delta is secondary
T198_primary.primary_metric: subject-equal mean Spearman: average batch Spearman within each biological unit, then average equally over biological units
T198_primary.uncertainty: percentile bootstrap over biological units, 2,000 resamples
